name: Bikeep Mock
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if ! pgrep -f "uvicorn bikeep_mock:app" >/dev/null; then PYTHONPATH=. nohup uvicorn bikeep_mock:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 24533 >/tmp/bikeep_mock.log 2>&1 & fi'
